ai.literal: goodness and badness having examined, benefit who pursues - he of the nature to employ is fit.
ai.translation: He who weighs the good and the bad, and has the nature of pursuing what is beneficial, is fit to be employed.
ai.modern: ஒரு செயலின் நன்மையையும் தீமையையும் ஆராய்ந்து பார்த்து, நன்மையானவற்றையே செய்யும் இயல்புடையவனைப் பணியில் அமர்த்த வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the core qualification for choosing someone for a task. The phrase 'நாடி' (having examined) shows that the person must carefully weigh both the positive and negative outcomes of an action. The word 'புரிந்த' here takes the sense of 'doing' or 'pursuing', indicating that after analysis, the person actively chooses the beneficial path ('நலம்'). Only a person with such a discerning and constructive nature ('தன்மையான்') is fit to be employed ('ஆளப்படும்') and entrusted with responsibilities.

ai.literal: Income having increased, wealth having created, things that occur he who examines, let him do the task.
ai.translation: Entrust a task to one who can expand sources of income, create wealth, and analyze any obstacles that arise.
ai.modern: வருவாய்க்கான வழிகளைப் பெருக்கி, செல்வத்தை வளர்த்து, வரும் இடையூறுகளை ஆராய்ந்து தீர்க்க வல்லவனிடம் ஒரு செயலை ஒப்படைக்க வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the qualities of an ideal administrator or manager to whom a task should be entrusted. The chosen person must be capable of expanding sources of income and generating wealth. Furthermore, they must have the foresight and analytical skill to examine and resolve any obstacles that occur during the execution of the work. Only someone with these three abilities should be assigned the responsibility of a major task.

ai.literal: Affection, knowledge, clarity, desire-absence, these four-all, well he-who-possesses with-indeed trust.
ai.translation: Trust should be placed only in someone who fully possesses all these four qualities: loyalty, knowledge, clear judgment, and freedom from greed.
ai.modern: அன்பு, அறிவு, தெளிந்த சிந்தனை, பேராசை இல்லாமை ஆகிய இந்த நான்கு பண்புகளையும் தன்னிடம் முழுமையாகக் கொண்டிருப்பவரிடமே ஒரு செயலை ஒப்படைக்கும் நம்பிக்கையை வைக்க வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet lists the four essential qualities a leader must look for before trusting someone with a responsibility. The person must have 'அன்பு' (loyalty or affection) towards the leader or the cause, and 'அறிவு' (knowledge) to understand and execute the tasks. They must also possess 'தேற்றம்' (clarity of mind or clear judgment) and 'அவாவின்மை' (the absence of greed), ensuring they will not be confused or corrupted. The word 'தெளிவு' signifies the clear decision to trust and delegate, which should rest solely ('கட்டே') with one who has all four traits fully ('நன்கு').

words.gloss: by the nature of the work

ai.literal: in whatever way trusted even when, by the nature of the work different will become people many.
ai.translation: Even when they have been tested and trusted in every possible way, many people change when it comes to the actual execution of the work.
ai.modern: எல்லா வகையிலும் ஆராய்ந்து நம்பி ஒரு செயலை ஒப்படைத்தாலும், அந்தச் செயலைச் செய்யும்போது வேறுபட்டுப் போகின்ற மனிதர்கள் உலகில் பலர் உள்ளனர்.
ai.explanation: This couplet warns about the unpredictability of human behavior in practical situations. The phrase 'எனைவகையான் தேறியக் கண்ணும்' means that even after a leader has thoroughly tested and placed trust in someone using every available method. However, 'வினைவகையான் வேறாகும்' points out that the specific demands, pressures, or temptations of the work itself can cause them to act differently than expected. Therefore, it emphasizes that theoretical trustworthiness does not always guarantee practical success, as many people change when faced with the actual task.

ai.literal: Having known, having executed, to him who is able to do except, task indeed 'he is dear' saying of the nature of being commanded is not.
ai.translation: A task should not be entrusted to someone simply because he is dear; it should only be given to one who knows what to do, works hard, and has the ability to complete it.
ai.modern: ஒரு செயலை எப்படிச் செய்ய வேண்டும் என்று அறிந்து, அதற்கான முயற்சிகளை மேற்கொண்டு செய்து முடிக்கும் ஆற்றல் உடையவரிடம் மட்டுமே அச்செயலை ஒப்படைக்க வேண்டும். அவர் நமக்கு மிகவும் வேண்டியவர் என்று கருதி அவரிடம் ஒரு செயலை ஒப்படைக்கக் கூடாது.
ai.explanation: This couplet explains the criteria for delegating tasks. The phrase 'அறிந்து ஆற்றிச் செய்கிற்பாற்கு' emphasizes three qualities: knowing the nature of the work, putting in the required effort, and having the capacity to finish it. The word 'சிறந்தான்' here means someone who is dear or special to the leader. The couplet warns that personal affection should never be the reason for assigning a task; competence must be the only measure.

ai.literal: The doer having examined, the task having examined, with the time to suit having understood, act.
ai.translation: Examine the person who will do the work, examine the work itself, and having understood how it suits the time, execute it.
ai.modern: ஒரு செயலைச் செய்பவனின் திறமையை ஆராய்ந்து, செய்ய வேண்டிய செயலையும் ஆராய்ந்து, அது காலத்தோடு பொருந்துமாறு உணர்ந்து அச்செயலைச் செய்ய வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet outlines the three essential factors to consider before executing a task. First, one must evaluate the doer ('செய்வானை நாடி') to ensure they have the right skills. Second, the nature of the task itself ('வினை நாடி') must be thoroughly analyzed. Finally, one must understand how the task aligns with the current time ('காலத்தோடு எய்த உணர்ந்து') before proceeding with the action ('செயல்').

ai.literal: 'This task, by this means, this man will complete' - having considered and examined, that task with him leave.
ai.translation: Having carefully analyzed and concluded that 'this man will complete this task by this means,' entrust that task to him.
ai.modern: இந்தச் செயலை இந்தக் கருவியால் இவன் முடிப்பான் என்று ஆராய்ந்து அறிந்த பிறகு, அந்தச் செயலை அவனிடமே ஒப்படைக்க வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet explains the proper way to delegate a task. A leader must first carefully analyze three things: the nature of the task, the resources or methods required, and the capability of the person. Once it is determined that a specific person can successfully complete the task using the given means, the responsibility should be fully entrusted to them. The repetition of demonstrative pronouns emphasizes the precision required in matching the right person to the right job.

ai.literal: For a task, fitness having examined after, him for that as a fit person make.
ai.translation: After examining a person's fitness for a task, make him fully responsible for it.
ai.modern: ஒரு செயலைச் செய்வதற்கு ஒருவனுக்கு உள்ள தகுதியை ஆராய்ந்த பிறகு, அவனை அந்தச் செயலுக்கு முழுப் பொறுப்புடையவனாக ஆக்க வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet explains the proper way to delegate responsibility. First, a leader must carefully examine a person's skills and fitness ('உரிமை') for a specific task ('வினை'). Only after this thorough assessment ('நாடிய பின்றை') should the person be appointed. Once chosen, the leader must give him full authority and make him completely responsible ('உரியனாகச் செயல்') for that task, allowing him to execute it effectively.

ai.literal: In action, action he who possesses - friendship different to become - him who considers, will depart prosperity.
ai.translation: Prosperity will abandon the leader who thinks of altering his friendship with a man capable of executing the work.
ai.modern: ஒரு செயலைச் செய்து முடிக்கும் திறமை உடையவனின் நட்பை வேறுவிதமாக (சந்தேகத்துடன்) நினைப்பவனை விட்டுச் செல்வம் நீங்கிவிடும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet warns against mistrusting a capable worker once a task has been entrusted to them. The phrase 'வினைக்கண் வினையுடையான்' refers to a person who possesses the practical ability to accomplish a given task. 'கேண்மை வேறாக நினைப்பானை' describes a leader who alters his friendly relationship with such a worker, often out of unwarranted suspicion. If a leader alienates their most competent people through mistrust, 'திரு' or prosperity will naturally leave them, as success depends on capable execution.

ai.literal: Every day let examine the king, the worker's non-deviation; (if he) does not deviate, the world (will not deviate).
ai.translation: Let the king daily examine the uprightness of his officials. If they do not deviate from their duty, the world will not deviate from its course.
ai.modern: மன்னன் தன் காரியங்களைச் செய்யும் அதிகாரியின் நேர்மையை நாள்தோறும் ஆராய வேண்டும். அவன் நேர்மை தவறாமல் இருந்தால், உலகமும் தன் நிலையில் தவறாது.
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes the king's duty to constantly monitor his officials. The word 'நாடோறும்' (daily) stresses that this vigilance must be continuous, not occasional. 'வினைசெய்வான்' refers to the official executing the king's tasks. The repetition of the root 'கோடு' (to bend or deviate) connects the official's integrity directly to the stability of the state: if the official remains upright, the entire world under the king's rule will remain upright and just.
